hotspotBreakdown.scope: Unchanged snapshot/replay method bodies; sample proportions guide a new screen and are not a measured new speedup. Inlining can hide individual function frames. Inclusive regions overlap.

translation.scope: Only the conflict-resolved parallelism tooltip: localized lookup, all CPU/DOP tiers, and no added interpolation placeholders. No UI runtime or layout conclusion.
translation.sourceKey: 关闭时使用单线程搜索；2–16 是并行上限，实际并发还会受可独立分支数和内存安全准入限制，因此 CPU 不一定满载。提高可能加快大型搜索，也会增加 CPU、峰值内存和帧率压力；超过物理核心数通常只有小幅收益。默认按可用逻辑处理器选择：16 个及以上用 8 线程，4–15 个用 4 线程，2–3 个用 2 线程，其余用单线程；遇到疑似并行问题时请先上传问题包，再切换为关闭。
translation.english: Off uses one thread. Values 2–16 cap parallel workers; actual concurrency depends on independent branches and safe memory capacity, so CPU usage may stay below 100%. Higher values may speed up large searches but increase CPU, memory and frame pressure. Gains above physical core count are usually small. Defaults to 8 threads with 16 or more available logical processors, 4 with 4–15, 2 with 2–3, and 1 otherwise. If parallel search seems faulty, upload a report before switching it off.
